parameters.description: a list of names of input SD Measurementsets (only MS is allowed for this task)
parameters.name: infiles

parameters.description: prefix of output images (.image, .weight)
parameters.name: outfile

parameters.description: overwrite the output file if already exists [True, False]
parameters.name: overwrite

parameters.description: select data by field IDs and names, e.g. '3C2*' (''=all)
parameters.name: field

parameters.description: select data by IF IDs (spectral windows), e.g. '3,5,7' (''=all)
parameters.name: spw

parameters.description: select data by antenna names or IDs, e.g, 'PM03' ('' = all antennas)
parameters.name: antenna

parameters.description: select data by scan numbers, e.g. '21~23' (''=all)
parameters.name: scan

parameters.description: select data by observational intent, e.g. '*ON_SOURCE*' (''=all)
parameters.name: intent

parameters.description: select data by range of time, e.g. 20:15:00~20:16:00 (''=all)
parameters.name: timerange

parameters.description: velocity frame of output image (''=current frame or LSRK for multiple-MS inputs)
parameters.name: outframe

parameters.description: spectral gridding type ['channel', 'frequency', 'velocity']
parameters.name: mode

parameters.description: number of channels (planes) in output image (-1=all)
parameters.name: nchan

parameters.description: start of output spectral dimension, e.g. '0', '110GHz', '-20km/s'
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: width of output spectral channels
parameters.name: width

parameters.description: velocity definition
parameters.name: veltype

parameters.description: Spectral definition mode (cube, cubedata, cubesource)
parameters.name: specmode

parameters.description: Spectral interpolation ["nearest", "linear", "cubic"]
parameters.name: interpolation

parameters.description: pointing data column to use
parameters.name: pointingcolumn

parameters.description: Specify whether the direction of the specified pointing column must be converted to image"s reference frame prior to being interpolated at data-taking time, and when. "never": interpolate against the pointing column, then convert. "always": interpolate against the beforehand converted pointing column. "auto": if there are less pointings than selected data rows convert first, else interpolate first
parameters.name: convertfirst

parameters.description: map projection type
parameters.name: projection

parameters.description: x and y image size in pixels, e.g., [64,64]. Single value: same for both spatial axes ([] = number of pixels to cover whole pointings in MSes)
parameters.name: imsize

parameters.description: x and y cell size, (e.g., ['8arcsec','8arcsec']. default unit arcmin. ('' = 1/3 of FWHM of primary beam)
parameters.name: cell

parameters.description: image center direction: position or field index or ephemeris source info, e.g., 'J2000 17:30:15.0 -25.30.00.0', 'MARS'. ('' = the center of pointing directions in MSes)
parameters.name: phasecenter

parameters.description: stokes parameters or polarization types to image, e.g. 'I', 'XX'
parameters.name: stokes

parameters.description: gridding function for imaging (see description in help)
parameters.name: gridfunction

parameters.description: convolution support for gridding
parameters.name: convsupport

parameters.description: truncation radius for gridding
parameters.name: truncate

parameters.description: HWHM for gaussian
parameters.name: gwidth

parameters.description: c-parameter for jinc function
parameters.name: jwidth

parameters.description: Clip minimum and maximum value from each pixel. Note the benefit of clipping is lost when the number of integrations contributing to each gridded pixel is small, or where the incidence of spurious datapoints is approximately or greater than the number of beams (in area) encompassed by expected image.
parameters.name: clipminmax

parameters.description: Minimum weight ratio to the median of weight used in weight correction and weight beased masking
parameters.name: minweight

parameters.description: Overwrite the brightness unit in image ('' = respect the unit in MS) ['K' or 'Jy/beam'].
parameters.name: brightnessunit

parameters.description: rest frequency to assign to image, e.g., '114.5GHz'. When the default value '' is used, the task currently internally uses REST_FREQUENCY of SOURCE table or mean frequency of given spectral window as a default value.
parameters.name: restfreq
